title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc — Race Regulations: time limit and cut-off times
claims: Cut-off times for leaving the main aid stations are published on the event website and in the Runner's Guide; changes are announced by SMS.
To be authorized to continue, all participants must leave the checkpoint or aid station before the cut-off time, whatever their time of arrival.
Departing from a checkpoint after the time barrier is a disqualification breach under the regulation penalty table.
When the start is organized in several waves, the maximum authorized time and time barriers are calculated from the departure time of runners in the last wave.
